one_line: A 35-second Hebrew step-by-step craft reel by a parenting content creator: a green paper leaf with a pipe-cleaner caterpillar on a skewer that slides across it, tied to the children's board book הזחל הרעב, ending with a child playing with it.

hook.visual: Observed: selfie-style close-up of a woman with long brown hair in a black top, slight smile, holding a finished green paper leaf with a green pipe-cleaner caterpillar (red head, googly eyes) on a wooden skewer at chest height. The finished toy is in frame from 0.0.
hook.on_screen_text: אין מצב שלא תכינו את הזחל המתוק הזה (There is no way you won't make this sweet caterpillar), plus a caterpillar emoji
hook.first_spoken_line: אין מצב שלא תכינו את הזחר המתוק הזה (Whisper's spelling, the caption has זחל; There's no way you won't make this sweet caterpillar)
hook.why_it_stops_the_scroll: Inferred: the finished object is in her hand at 0.0 so the viewer sees the result before any effort; the negative imperative ('no way you won't') frames it as easy and unmissable; a human face with eye contact opens the clip before it turns to hands-only steps.

beats.observed: Creator holds the finished leaf and caterpillar toward the lens, smiling.
beats.spoken: Whisper: אין מצב שלא תכינו את הזחר המתוק הזה
beats.on_screen_text: אין מצב שלא תכינו את הזחל המתוק הזה (There is no way you won't make this sweet caterpillar)

beats.observed: Still on the creator at 3.0, then a cut at 4.5 to a top-down table scene: leaf with caterpillar, butterfly stickers, a wicker basket with white flowers, and a board book.
beats.spoken: Whisper: a spring, super cute craft that can also be an activity for the book (Hebrew, with the same זחל/זחר misspelling)
beats.on_screen_text: יצירה אביבית וסופר חמודה / שיכולה גם להיות פעילות לספר הזחל הרעב (A spring, super cute craft / that can also be an activity for the book The Very Hungry Caterpillar)

beats.observed: Hands only. Green cardstock is rolled around a wooden skewer, then a cardstock strip is rolled into a short tube and a glue line is drawn on the leaf at about 10.5 s; the tube is glued to the base of the leaf by 12.0. The board book titled הזחל הרעב is visible at right.
beats.spoken: Whisper: I made a big leaf from green bristol; I took a bristol strip, rolled it into a tube and glued it to the bottom of the leaf
beats.on_screen_text: הכנתי עלה גדול מבריסטול ירוק / לקחתי רצועת בריסטול גילגלתי לגליל / והדבקתי בחלק התחתון של העלה (I made a big leaf from green bristol / I took a strip of bristol, rolled it into a tube / and glued it to the bottom part of the leaf)

beats.observed: Green and red pipe cleaners are shown, then the green one is wound tightly around a wooden skewer, hands filling the frame.
beats.spoken: Whisper: to make the caterpillar I used pipe cleaners, wrapped them tight on a skewer
beats.on_screen_text: כדי להכין את הזחל השתמשתי במנקי מקטרות / ליפפתי את מנקה המקטרות צפוף צפוף על שיפוד (To make the caterpillar I used pipe cleaners / I wrapped the pipe cleaner very tightly on a skewer)

beats.observed: A red tip is attached at the end of the skewer at 18.0; at 19.5 a retail pack labelled עיניים ליצירה 200 יחידות (Craft eyes, 200 units) with a printed MAX HOBBY logo is held up beside the skewer; at 21.0 the finished caterpillar is lifted off the skewer and held in fingertips with the eyes on.
beats.spoken: Whisper: just like you see in the video, glued googly eyes, carefully remove it from the skewer. The remove-from-skewer line has no caption.
beats.on_screen_text: ממש כמו שאתם רואים בסרטון / והדבקתי עיניים זזות / ותראו את הזחל החמוד הזה (Just like you see in the video / and I glued googly eyes / and look at this cute caterpillar), plus a heart-eyes emoji

beats.observed: The bare skewer is pushed into the cardstock tube on the leaf; at 24.0 a black hot glue gun is applying glue; the caterpillar is pressed onto the top of the skewer by 25.5 to 28.5.
beats.spoken: Whisper: the skewer goes into the tube on the leaf, spread glue on the top of the tube and the top of the skewer, stick the caterpillar
beats.on_screen_text: את השיפוד מכניסים לתוך הגליל שעל העלה / ומורחים דבק בחלק העליון של הגליל ובחלק העליון של השיפוד / ומדביקים את הזחל (The skewer goes into the tube on the leaf / and glue goes on the top of the tube and the top of the skewer / and stick the caterpillar)

beats.observed: Close-up on a second, yellow-bodied caterpillar with a pink head on the leaf at 30.0 (a colour variant). Stills cannot confirm any motion; the movement is stated in speech and caption.
beats.spoken: Whisper: every time you move the skewer the caterpillar will crawl and move on the leaf
beats.on_screen_text: בכל פעם שתזיזו את השיפוד הזחל יזחל ויזוז על העלה (Every time you move the skewer the caterpillar will crawl and move on the leaf)

beats.observed: A child in a white graffiti-print t-shirt holds the skewer from under the leaf with the yellow-pink caterpillar on top, smiling (at 31.5 the lower half of a smiling face is visible; at 33.0 only hands and torso). The board book sits below.
beats.spoken: Whisper: the kids are going to flip out over this
beats.on_screen_text: הילדים הולכים לעוף על זה (The kids are going to flip out over this), followed by heart and caterpillar emoji

beats.observed: Back to a close-up of the green caterpillar on the leaf above the board book, child's torso behind.
beats.spoken: Whisper: share with whoever has to make one too
beats.on_screen_text: שתפו עם מי שחייב להכין כזה גם ! (Share with whoever has to make one of these too!)

payoff: The finished toy is shown at 0.0 and 21.0, the explanation of how it moves arrives at 28.5-31.5, and the child using it at 31.5-34.0. The share ask lands at about 34.5.
cta: On-screen and spoken near the end: שתפו עם מי שחייב להכין כזה גם ! (Share with whoever has to make one of these too!) at about 34.5 s. The post caption is only זה כזה חמוד (It's so cute) with emoji.
share_or_comment_trigger: Inferred: someone sends it to a parent, kindergarten teacher or relative who needs a quick activity, and saves it for the supply list and steps; the book tie-in makes it recognisable. 459 comments (0.04% of views); comments were not read and shares and saves are not in meta.json.
why_it_worked: Numbers: 1,121,717 views against an account median of 37,886 (29.6x), with 10,477 likes (0.93% like rate) and 459 comments. A breakout well beyond the follower base, probably driven by shares and saves, which meta.json does not report (inferred).
Outcome-first hook plus cheap, visible materials: every step is on screen, captioned and 1.5 to 3 s long, so it works sound-off, and the 'how does it move' loop pays off at 28.5-34.0.
Anchored to a children's book that Israeli parents recognise (the board book is visible in most frames from 4.5 to 34.5), which gives the craft a reason to exist and a literacy angle (inferred).
paid_signal: no: like_rate_pct is 0.93, above the 0.3 paid-promotion signal, the caption is a casual four-word line and no sponsor label is shown; a retail-branded googly-eyes pack is visible at 19.5 but looks incidental, whether it was gifted is unclear.

solo_route.how: 1) Buy cheap craft supplies (green cardstock, pipe cleaners, wooden skewers, googly eyes, a hot glue gun) and build one off-camera to test the mechanism: the skewer slides inside a rolled cardstock tube glued to the leaf, so moving the skewer moves the figure. 2) Film top-down on a phone tripod, hands only, 1 to 3 s per step, plus a 3 s selfie opening holding the finished piece; cut each step in CapCut and add small white auto-captions in the same style, with a short voiceover. 3) LumeBook twist: take the child hero from a LumeBook preview illustration (or generate the hero with LumeBook's own illustration AI), remove the background, print it in Canva and glue it to the skewer so the hero 'walks' across a paper scene or an open book spread. 4) End on the hero sliding across the spread as the payoff instead of a child, or use a relative's child's hands only.
solo_route.needs: Nothing essential. Optional: a relative's child (hands or face) with parental consent for the payoff shot. Avoid showing The Very Hungry Caterpillar book or its artwork, as it is a third-party licensed work; use LumeBook's own pages (inferred caution, not legal advice).

lumebook_version.hook_he: אין מצב שלא תכינו את הגיבור מהספר של לומבוק
lumebook_version.concept: A stick-puppet craft where the child's own LumeBook hero (the AI illustration from the free preview) is printed, glued to a skewer and slid across a paper scene, so the family can act out the story at home. Same outcome-first opening: hold up the finished hero puppet at 0:00, then caption the steps.

evidence_notes: Observed: all 4 sheets plus single frames at 0.0, 3.0, 4.5, 7.5, 9.0, 12.0, 15.0, 18.0, 19.5, 21.0, 22.5, 25.5, 27.0, 30.0, 33.0 and 34.5, and upscaled crops of the captions at 9.0 and 19.5 to confirm spelling (גילגלתי, עיניים זזות). Captions are small, white and mid-frame, so legibility on a phone is modest. Whisper is decent here and matches the captions closely, but spells זחל as זחר, garbles ומורחים as ומומחים, and includes one spoken step (carefully remove from the skewer, 19.6-22.3) that has no caption. Caterpillar movement is not visible in stills; it is claimed in speech and caption only. The child at 31.5-34.0 shows only lower face, hands and torso; not identified, and the relation to the creator is not stated. The account name describes a parenting and kids content creator, and no children's expert credential is shown, so made_by is left unclear (an independent creator's own post, no brand shown). The board book in frame shows the Hebrew title הזחל הרעב and a byline naming Eric Carle. No audio inspected: voice, tone and music not described.
